description: Outcome eval at scale (issue #163): candidate tasks over Django 5.1.4 (the django/ package and its tests/) and Vue 3.5.46 (vuejs/core, packages/*/src and __tests__) - transitive callers, blast radius, same-name disambiguation, call-chain flows, which tests reach a function, and questions that are not about calls. Gold sets were computed by evals/agent/groundtruth/scale_tasks.py from Python's ast module and the TypeScript type checker, never from myceliums output. Each gold item lists one evidence line that check-tasks re-verifies; its note gives the level and the next hop, or why it counts.

tasks.question: Which functions or methods in the `django/` package call `conditional_escape` (django/utils/html.py) directly, call such a caller - that is, every caller up to two levels up the call chain? Consider only the `django/` package (not `tests/`, `docs/` or other top-level directories). Count direct calls by name: imported names and re-exports count (also imports inside a function body and `module.function(...)` after `from django.utils import formats`), and so do calls through `self`, `cls` or `super()`, which count for the method the enclosing class defines or inherits from its base classes (not for overrides in subclasses), and class instantiation by the class's name, which counts as a call of the `__init__` the class defines or inherits. A call inside a nested function, lambda or decorator wrapper counts for the outermost enclosing function or method. Calls on other objects' attributes (for example `model_admin.get_queryset(request)`, `self.storage.path(name)`, `request.user.has_perm(...)`), instantiation through a variable (`redirect_class(url)`) and passing a function as a value (decorators applied with `@`, callbacks) do not count. Ignore docstrings and comments. Do not list `conditional_escape` itself.
tasks.rationale: HTML escaping: level 1 spans template nodes, filters and `format_html`; level 2 reaches the admin helpers and templatetags, forms rendering and the i18n template tags. Computed from the py_edges.py --local-imports --star-imports (import-aware AST, `direct` edges) call graph; 36 items.
